en: I feel like nobody talks about what your 20s are actually like they’re a lot harder than it looks.
zh: 我觉得没人聊过20多岁到底是什么样的，其实生活比看起来要难得多。

en: I feel like I’m always second guessing my career.
zh: 我感觉我总是在质疑自己的职业选择。

en: I’m still trying to make new friends in my 20s which is hard.
zh: 20多岁了还在努力交新朋友，这真的挺难的。

en: moving to a new city alone post-grad.
zh: 毕业后一个人搬到一个全新的城市。

en: I decided I just want to start documenting it and kind of figuring it out as I go.
zh: 我决定就这样开始，边走边摸索。

en: I don’t want this to be deep.
zh: 我不想把这事说得太深奥。

en: I just want it to be honest.
zh: 我只想坦诚一点。

en: and this is me just figuring out my 20s except I’m filming it.
zh: 这就是我摸索20岁生活的过程，只不过我把它拍了下来。

en: starting off strong the daily routine we already know by now.
zh: 先从大家已经熟知的日常习惯开始。

en: I go to coffee shops to work because I need to get out of my apartment at least once a day.
zh: 我去咖啡馆办公，因为我每天至少得走出公寓一次。

en: I don’t know what this says about me.
zh: 我不知道这说明了什么。

en: but I am significantly more productive when I leave.
zh: 但只要出门，我的办事效率就会显著提高。

en: and I also just feel honestly a little bit less lonely being around other people.
zh: 而且说实话，周围有人的时候，我感觉没那么孤独。

en: even if I’m not interacting with them.
zh: 哪怕我并没有和他们交流。

en: and it’s almost like I have co-workers this way because I’m you know I work by myself a lot.
zh: 这样感觉就像有了同事，因为你们知道，我经常一个人工作。

en: I guess co-workers might be a stretch but you know what I’m saying.
zh: 说是“同事”可能有点牵强，但你们懂我的意思。

en: never in my life have I had strawberry tea.
zh: 我这辈子还没喝过草莓茶。

en: I think I’m gonna be getting it often.
zh: 我想以后我会经常点这个。

en: I didn’t even know this existed I don't know if I'm the only one my new fixation is going to be this.
zh: 我以前都不知道，这简直要成为我的新宠了。

en: so one of the stranger things for me strange things not talking about the show.
zh: 对我来说比较奇怪的一件事——不是说《怪奇物语》那部剧哈。

en: I have to like schedule almost my calls now with my friends with my like mom my brother.
zh: 我现在跟朋友、老妈还有我哥打电话，几乎都得提前约时间。

en: as I get older everyone’s like so busy.
zh: 随着年龄增长，大家好像都特别忙。

en: and I still want to make time for the people that I love.
zh: 而我还是想为我爱的人留出时间。

en: but I feel like I don’t call people on a whim much anymore.
zh: 但我感觉现在不再是心血来潮就给人打电话了。

en: like I have to like really be intentional about it.
zh: 就像我必须得特意去做这件事。

en: enough to say I’m calling my mom on her lunch break at work just to say hi because I miss her.
zh: 甚至我会趁我妈午休时给她打个电话，就为了说声“嗨”，因为我想她了。

en: I absolutely dread cleaning out my closet.
zh: 我真的非常害怕清理衣柜。

en: I hate it I hate it.
zh: 超讨厌，真的超讨厌。

en: I think I just like hate making decisions.
zh: 我觉得我可能只是讨厌做决定。

en: I’m so indecisive I feel like I can’t let go of these clothes even if I haven’t worn something for six months.
zh: 我太纠结了，哪怕一件衣服半年没穿，我还是舍不得扔。

en: I feel some sort of deep attachment to it and I can’t get rid of it.
zh: 我对它们有种莫名的深厚感情，就是没法断舍离。

en: I really I’m starting to think I should unpack that at a later time.
zh: 我真的开始觉得，这个问题我以后得找时间深究一下。

en: I try to do like mini little resets of my closet every couple months versus once a year doing a whole clean out.
zh: 我尝试每隔几个月给衣柜做一次微调，而不是一年才大扫除一次。

en: I think it’s like a lot easier that way.
zh: 我觉得那样会轻松得多。

en: being in my 20s truly is just full of mini resets.
zh: 20多岁的生活真的充满了各种微小的重启。

en: I’m constantly me resetting something.
zh: 我总是在不断地调整和重来。

en: I actually found this organization that comes and picks up my donations for me.
zh: 我发现了一家可以上门接收捐赠物品的机构。

en: I usually do it like once a month so it’s been really helpful.
zh: 我通常一个月捐一次，这真的帮了我大忙。

en: and kind of just like makes me more motivated to get rid of stuff.
zh: 也会让我更有动力去清理东西。

en: I know this doesn’t look that drastic but I have two piles.
zh: 虽然看起来没那么夸张，但我分出了两堆。

en: this one is a pile that I need to get hemmed.
zh: 这一堆是需要拿去缝边改短的。

en: unfortunately all of my pants need to get hemmed.
zh: 遗憾的是，我所有的裤子都要改裤脚。

en: if you guys have any like short girl pants brands very niche let me know.
zh: 如果你们知道什么适合小个子女孩的裤子品牌，哪怕很小众，也请告诉我。

en: because this is always my issue.
zh: 因为这总是我最头疼的问题。

en: and then this pile is stuff that I’m donating.
zh: 然后这一堆则是要捐掉的。

en: I already feel like 30 times better after that.
zh: 做完这些，我感觉心情立马好了几十倍。

en: my mind feels like so much clearer.
zh: 脑子都感觉清爽多了。

en: I am gonna get ready though because I’m gonna go to a little SoulCycle class.
zh: 我要准备一下，因为一会儿要去上一节动感单车课。

en: I do need to make some dinner prior.
zh: 去之前我确实得先做点晚饭。

en: but I’ve been trying to push myself out of my comfort zone a little bit with my workouts specifically.
zh: 我最近一直在努力跳出舒适区，特别是在健身方面。

en: I’m trying to go to like new or just different workout classes then I usually do.
zh: 我尝试去参加一些以前没试过或者不一样的健身课。

en: honestly a lot of it I think for me is social.
zh: 说实话，我觉得很大一部分原因是为了社交。

en: I find that I meet new people at classes.
zh: 我发现能在课上遇到新面孔。

en: I like make new friends.
zh: 我喜欢交新朋友。

en: well honestly actually I never really make friends but that’s the point.
zh: 好吧，其实我也没真交到过朋友，但这才是重点。

en: that’s what I’m trying to do.
zh: 这正是我努力的目标。

en: not even friends I guess I’m just trying to like socialize a little bit more.
zh: 也不一定是交朋友，我猜我只是想多接触下人群。

en: I haven’t gone to SoulCycle and I think like over two years.
zh: 我有大概两年多没去过 SoulCycle 了。

en: it’s been so long so I’m prompt to signed up for a class 20 minutes ago for later tonight.
zh: 太久没去了，所以我 20 分钟前刚报了今晚的一节课。

en: so I’m just gonna chill for a bit.
zh: 所以我打算先休息一会儿。

en: and then I think start dinner soon.
zh: 然后准备开始做晚饭。
